items.quote: Behold, when I come unto the children of Israel, and shall say unto them, The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you; and they shall say to me, What is his name? what shall I say unto them?
items.claim: When Moses tells the children of Israel that God sent him, they will ask for God's name

items.quote: And God said unto Moses, I AM THAT I AM
items.claim: God told Moses his name is I AM THAT I AM

items.quote: Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel, I AM hath sent me unto you
items.claim: God commanded Moses to tell the children of Israel that I AM sent him
